report.label: Final report
report.basis: Bill list from the Long Term Care Ombudsman Program's posted tracker for the week of 3/23/2026. Bills added to the Program's list after that date are not included.

disclaimer: Research support for residents, families and advocates. Listing a bill here is not an endorsement or a position of the Connecticut Long Term Care Ombudsman Program.

lists.description: Nursing homes, assisted living, managed residential communities, CCRCs and residential care homes

statuses.detail: Joint favorable report; no floor vote

statuses.detail: Heard in committee; no favorable vote

also_enacted.label: Budget adjustments
also_enacted.summary: Nursing home Medicaid rate changes, including performance payments and a phase-in of the federal PDPM payment model; repeals a planned 6% nursing home tax; allows a small-house waiver of the two-bed room limit through July 1, 2027.

also_enacted.label: Budget implementer
also_enacted.summary: Excludes nursing home directors and assistant directors from required wage increases and adjusts the two-bed limit and certificate-of-need rules.

also_enacted.label: Public health revisions
also_enacted.summary: Creates a DPH working group on whether to license managed residential communities (assisted living).

also_enacted.label: Veterans
also_enacted.summary: Creates the task force on nursing homes contracting with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs proposed in SB 281.

also_enacted.label: Human services revisions
also_enacted.summary: Broadens the Long-Term Care Planning Committee's study topics and membership, similar to SB 495.

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING ABSENTEE VOTING FOR ALL AND VARIOUS OTHER REFORMS RELATED TO THE ADMINISTRATION OF ELECTIONS.
bills.summary: Removes restrictions on who may vote by absentee ballot and makes a range of other changes to election administration, including electronic ballot delivery and audit procedures.
bills.latest_action: Signed by the Governor

bills.title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE GOVERNOR'S BUDGET RECOMMENDATIONS FOR HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES.
bills.summary: Implements the Governor's budget recommendations for health and human services.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT STREAMLINING HEALTH CARE FACILITY APPROVALS.
bills.summary: Implements the Governor's budget recommendations on streamlining health care facility approvals.
bills.latest_action: Passed House; tabled for the Senate calendar

bills.title: AN ACT INCREASING THE HIGHEST MARGINAL RATE OF THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX.
bills.summary: Increases the highest marginal personal income tax rate from 6.99 percent to 7.99 percent.
bills.latest_action: Public hearing held; no committee vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR SCHOOL MEALS.
bills.summary: Reimburses school districts for the difference between the federal reimbursement rate for reduced-price meals and the rate for fully paid meals.
bills.latest_action: Public hearing held; no committee vote

bills.title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF AN ALERT IN THE STATE-WIDE HEALTH INFORMATION EXCHANGE REGARDING PATIENTS WITH A HISTORY OF VIOLENCE OR COMBATIVE BEHAVIOR TOWARD A HEALTH CARE PROVIDER.
bills.summary: Requires a method of alerting health care providers about patients reported in the state-wide Health Information Exchange as violent or combative toward a provider.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT EXEMPTING INCOME OF UP TO ONE HUNDRED THOUSAND DOLLARS EARNED BY A CHILD UNDER THE AGE OF TWENTY-FOUR FROM INCLUSION IN THE PARENT'S GROSS INCOME FOR DETERMINATION OF THE PARENT'S ELIGIBILITY TO PARTICIPATE IN THE RENTAL ASSISTANCE PROGRAM.
bills.summary: Excludes up to $100,000 earned by a child living with a parent from the parent's gross income when determining rental assistance program eligibility.
bills.latest_action: Public hearing held; no committee vote

bills.title: AN ACT PERMITTING MUNICIPALITIES TO PROHIBIT RENT INCREASES IN THE EVENT OF MULTIPLE STATE BUILDING CODE VIOLATIONS.
bills.summary: Allows municipalities to prohibit rent increases on residential properties with multiple outstanding State Building Code violations.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING ASSET LIMITS FOR HUSKY C BENEFICIARIES.
bills.summary: Raises the HUSKY C asset limit from $1,600 to $5,000 for unmarried persons and from $2,400 to $7,500 for married persons.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; no floor vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING RESIDENTIAL CARE HOME RATES, FAIR RENT AND ADMINISTRATOR SALARIES.
bills.summary: Supports residential care homes by ensuring adequate state reimbursement rates.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; no floor vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REMOVAL OF UNAUTHORIZED PERSONS FROM RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY.
bills.summary: Allows immediate removal of certain unauthorized persons from residential property.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING MODULAR OR PREFABRICATED HOMES.
bills.summary: Requires zoning regulations to allow modular or prefabricated homes as of right on lots where single-family homes are permitted, with a quarter housing-unit-equivalent point for each.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING LIMITATIONS ON THE USE ON NONCOMPETE AGREEMENTS.
bills.summary: Prohibits noncompete and exclusivity agreements unless they meet certain criteria.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH'S RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING CONSENT ORDERS.
bills.summary: Lets the Public Health Commissioner attach conditions to permits and licenses and resolve enforcement actions by agreed settlement or consent order without a formal hearing.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE OFFICE OF STATE ETHICS FOR REVISIONS TO THE STATE CODES OF ETHICS, REDEFINING "GIFT" FOR PURPOSES OF SAID CODES AND INCREASING VARIOUS MONETARY THRESHOLDS IN SAID CODES.
bills.summary: Revises the state codes of ethics: changes Ethics Board quorum, prohibits nepotism, broadens conflict-of-interest provisions, and raises various monetary thresholds.
bills.latest_action: Signed by the Governor

bills.title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CAREGIVER TAX CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX.
bills.summary: Establishes a caregiver tax credit against the personal income tax.
bills.latest_action: Referred to committee; no hearing

bills.title: AN ACT REQUIRING NURSING HOMES TO ANNUALLY REPORT CERTAIN OWNERSHIP INFORMATION REGARDING INVESTMENT ENTITIES, ACQUIRE, IF FEASIBLE, A SURETY BOND OR A SIMILAR FORM OF SECURITY IN AN AMOUNT EQUAL TO NINETY DAYS OF OPERATING COSTS, MAINTAIN FULL GOVERNANCE CONTROL AND AUTHORITY OVER NURSING HOME ASSETS AND ACTIVITIES AND ANNUALLY ATTEST THAT NO INVESTMENT ENTITY HAS CONTROL OVER NURSING HOME RESIDENT HEALTH, SAFETY OR CARE.
bills.summary: Requires nursing homes to report investment-entity (private equity) ownership each year, keep governance control, attest that no investment entity controls care, and may require a surety bond.
bills.latest_action: Signed by the Governor

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING PATIENT PROTECTIONS AND STANDARDS OF CARE AT CONNECTICUT VALLEY HOSPITAL.
bills.summary: Requires the Commissioner of Mental Health and Addiction Services to keep persons undergoing psychiatric evaluation at Connecticut Valley Hospital separated by biological sex at all times.
bills.latest_action: Public hearing held; no committee vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES RESPONSE TIME TRANSPARENCY.
bills.summary: Requires the Public Health Commissioner to establish a dashboard collecting and displaying emergency medical services response time data.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the Senate calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PURCHASE OF RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY BY PRIVATE EQUITY ENTITIES.
bills.summary: Requires a 75-day waiting period before private equity entities may offer to purchase one- or two-family homes.
bills.latest_action: Passed Senate; no House vote

bills.title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY MEANS OF ENCOURAGING MORE NURSING HOMES IN THE STATE TO CONTRACT WITH THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS.
bills.summary: Establishes a task force to study ways to encourage more Connecticut nursing homes to contract with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs to care for veterans.
bills.latest_action: Public hearing held; no committee vote

bills.title: AN ACT EXPANDING EMERGENCY MEDICAID COVERAGE.
bills.summary: Expands emergency Medicaid coverage to the extent permissible under federal law.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the Senate calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING LIMITATIONS ON THE USE OF NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENTS.
bills.summary: Prohibits the use of nondisclosure agreements in certain workplace circumstances.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the Senate calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT DISREGARDING THE CASH VALUE OF LIFE INSURANCE POLICIES IN ELIGIBILITY DETERMINATIONS FOR CERTAIN PUBLIC ASSISTANCE PROGRAMS.
bills.summary: Disregards the cash value of life insurance policies when determining eligibility for Medicaid, temporary family assistance, state supplement and state-administered general assistance.
bills.latest_action: Public hearing held; no committee vote

bills.title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE OFFICE OF GOVERNMENT OVERSIGHT.
bills.summary: Establishes an Office of Government Oversight to investigate fraud and waste in government.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the Senate calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ELECTRONIC SURVEILLANCE OF EMPLOYEES.
bills.summary: Requires employers to notify employees of where electronic surveillance occurs and which prohibited activities may trigger surveillance without prior notice.
bills.latest_action: Signed by the Governor

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING PREVENTING FRAUD IN THE SUPPLEMENTAL NUTRITION ASSISTANCE PROGRAM AND EXPRESSLY EXTENDING FRAUD AND CORRUPTION PENALTIES TO PUBLIC SERVANTS.
bills.summary: Deters fraud in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program and includes federal officials among public servants subject to state corrupt-practices laws affecting Medicaid and other state programs.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the Senate calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE MEMBERSHIP AND STUDY FOCUS OF THE LONG-TERM CARE PLANNING COMMITTEE.
bills.summary: Expands the scope of study of long-term care needs by the Long-Term Care Planning Committee, along with its membership.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the Senate calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT EXEMPTING HANDICAP RAMPS FOR RESIDENTIAL USE FROM THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
bills.summary: Exempts handicap ramps for residential use from the sales and use taxes.
bills.latest_action: Referred to committee; no hearing

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT FOR SAFETY ESCORTS.
bills.summary: Ensures the safety of behavioral health nurses who provide community-based care to Medicaid beneficiaries by addressing Medicaid reimbursement for safety escorts.
bills.latest_action: Referred to committee; no hearing

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADULT DAY CENTER TRANSPORTATION.
bills.summary: Raises the adult day care services fee schedule by ten percent effective July 1, 2026, to fund adult day care transportation, with annual cost-of-living increases.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING A FIVE-YEAR MEDICAID RATE REVIEW, DENTAL REPRESENTATION ON A MEDICAL ASSISTANCE OVERSIGHT COUNCIL, BIOMARKER TESTING AND OPIOID PRESCRIPTION COVERAGE REQUIREMENTS AND A STUDY CONCERNING PAYMENT OF SPOUSES FOR STATE-SUBSIDIZED HOME CARE.
bills.summary: Increases Medicaid reimbursement rates for certain providers, requires a five-year rate review, and addresses biomarker testing, opioid coverage, dental council representation and a study on paying spouses for home care.
bills.latest_action: Signed by the Governor

bills.title: AN ACT REQUIRING HOME HEALTH AIDE AGENCIES TO PROVIDE CERTAIN PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT TO HOME HEALTH AIDES.
bills.summary: Requires home health aide agencies to provide personal protective equipment to home health aide employees.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the Senate calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID RATE INCREASES.
bills.summary: Increases Medicaid provider rates to improve access to quality health care.
bills.latest_action: Referred to committee; no hearing

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF A CONNECTICUT OPTION FOR AFFORDABLE HEALTH CARE, HEALTH INSURER REQUIREMENTS FOR CERTAIN GENERIC DRUGS, TAX CREDITS FOR SMALL BUSINESS HEALTH CARE ARRANGEMENTS AND WORKER PORTABLE BENEFIT ACCOUNTS.
bills.summary: Governor's bill covering a study of a Connecticut health care option, generic drug insurer requirements, small business health care tax credits and portable benefit accounts.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING TO INCREASE MEDICAID RATES FOR PRIVATE PROVIDERS.
bills.summary: Increases funding for Medicaid rates for private providers in accordance with the Medicaid rate study.
bills.latest_action: Referred to committee; no hearing

bills.title: AN ACT ALLOWING DENTAL HYGIENISTS TO PROVIDE DENTAL HYGIENE SERVICES IN PATIENTS' PRIVATE RESIDENCES.
bills.summary: Allows dental hygienists to provide dental hygiene services in patients' private residences.
bills.latest_action: Passed House; tabled for the Senate calendar

bills.title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS TO ASSIST HOMELESS PERSONS.
bills.summary: Provides funding to the Department of Housing to assist homeless persons.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; no floor vote

bills.title: AN ACT ADJUSTING THE FISCAL GUARDRAILS.
bills.summary: Changes how thresholds for volatility fund transfers are calculated and raises the maximum capacity of the Budget Reserve Fund.
bills.latest_action: Public hearing held; no committee vote

bills.title: AN ACT PROHIBITING A LANDLORD FROM REQUIRING A SECURITY DEPOSIT IN EXCESS OF ONE MONTH'S RENT FROM ANY TENANT.
bills.summary: Prohibits landlords from requiring a security deposit greater than one month's rent from any tenant.
bills.latest_action: Public hearing held; no committee vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING UTILITY CONNECTIONS FOR ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS.
bills.summary: Replaces 'accessory apartments' with 'accessory dwelling units' in statute and bars requiring separate utility connections for accessory apartments under special act zoning regulations.
bills.latest_action: Signed by the Governor

bills.title: AN ACT PROHIBITING REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT TRUSTS FROM ACQUIRING OR INCREASING OPERATIONAL CONTROL OVER HOSPITALS OR HEALTH SYSTEMS AND PROHIBITING HOSPITALS AND HEALTH SYSTEMS FROM ENTERING INTO SALE-LEASEBACK FINANCING TRANSACTIONS.
bills.summary: Bars real estate investment trusts from acquiring or increasing control over hospitals or health systems, and bars hospital main-campus sale-leaseback transactions.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; no floor vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROVISIONS IN RESIDENTIAL RENTAL AGREEMENTS.
bills.summary: Requires a free rent payment method, bars rent increases as a penalty for lease breaches, bans post-lease automatic rent-increase clauses, and requires disclosure of late fees.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MEDICAL RESPITE PILOT PROGRAM.
bills.summary: Establishes a medical respite pilot program providing supportive care to homeless individuals undergoing medical treatment.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; no floor vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REVIEW OF HEALTH CARE ENTITY TRANSACTIONS, THE EXPANSION OF EQUITABLE RELIEF AND ENFORCEMENT TOOLS AVAILABLE UNDER THE CONNECTICUT ANTITRUST ACT AND THE INCLUSION OF ADDITIONAL INFORMATION IN HOSPITAL PRICEMASTER FILINGS.
bills.summary: Strengthens review of health care entity transactions, expands Connecticut Antitrust Act remedies, and requires more information in hospital pricemaster filings.
bills.latest_action: Public hearing held; no committee vote

bills.title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE EFFECTS OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE ON THE TRADES INDUSTRY.
bills.summary: Establishes a task force on the effects of artificial intelligence on the trades industry and requires the Public Health commissioner to study a certified nursing assistant training program.
bills.latest_action: Passed House; tabled for the Senate calendar

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH'S RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING REAL PROPERTY CHANGE OF OWNERSHIP.
bills.summary: Amends the health care facility change-of-ownership approval process to include the real property owner.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING VARIOUS REVISIONS TO HUMAN SERVICES STATUTES.
bills.summary: Makes technical and other changes to human services statutes, including posting DSS elder-abuse reporting contacts in the managed residential community bill of rights and adopting federal nursing home resident-rights rules.
bills.latest_action: Signed by the Governor

bills.title: AN ACT SUSPENDING INFLATION COST LIMITATIONS FOR INTERMEDIATE CARE FACILITIES.
bills.summary: Suspends inflation cost limitations to reduce financial burdens on Medicaid-funded intermediate care facilities.
bills.latest_action: Referred to committee; no hearing

bills.title: AN ACT PROHIBITING CERTAIN LAND USE AND ZONING LIMITATIONS ON HOUSING.
bills.summary: Bars local governments from certain zoning limits on single-family lots and housing types and from prohibiting certain lot subdivisions.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the Senate calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING LICENSURE FOR LONG-TERM ACUTE CARE HOSPITALS.
bills.summary: Establishes licensure for long-term acute care hospitals.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; no floor vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF REESTABLISHING THE DUTIES, RESPONSIBILITIES AND STAFFING OF THE LEGISLATIVE PROGRAM REVIEW AND INVESTIGATIONS COMMITTEE.
bills.summary: Requires the Office of Legislative Management to study reestablishing the duties, responsibilities and staffing of the Legislative Program Review and Investigations Committee.
bills.latest_action: Passed Senate; no House vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING EVICTIONS FOR CAUSE.
bills.summary: Requires cause for eviction of certain tenants and residents of mobile manufactured home parks.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the Senate calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMERGENCY POWER GENERATOR REQUIREMENTS FOR CERTAIN MULTIFAMILY HOUSING PROJECTS.
bills.summary: Requires certain privately owned multifamily housing projects to install and maintain emergency power generators.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the Senate calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT REQUIRING NURSING HOMES TO SPEND EIGHTY PER CENT OF REVENUE ON DIRECT PATIENT CARE.
bills.summary: Requires nursing homes to spend 80 percent of revenue on direct patient care.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the Senate calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROBATE COURT OPERATIONS.
bills.summary: Changes Probate Court processes and procedures, including conservatorship hearing notices and conservator financial audits.
bills.latest_action: Signed by the Governor

bills.title: AN ACT EXPANDING LONG-TERM CARE OPTIONS.
bills.summary: Rebalances the state's long-term care plan to offer more home-based and community living options.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the Senate calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING VEXATIOUS REQUESTERS UNDER THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT.
bills.summary: Lets harassing and threatening conduct outside a records request count in finding a vexatious requester and lengthens relief when a petition is granted again.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the Senate calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROVISION OF ANNUAL TRAINING TO A PERSON APPOINTED AS A CONSERVATOR IN A PROBATE COURT PROCEEDING.
bills.summary: Requires the Probate Court Administrator to establish an annual training program for persons appointed as conservators.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the Senate calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT REQUIRING NURSING HOME OWNERSHIP TRANSPARENCY, FINANCIAL SAFEGUARDS PROTECTING NURSING HOME OPERATIONS AND PROPERTY AND PROHIBITING REQUIRED ARBITRATION AGREEMENTS.
bills.summary: Sets financial safeguards on private equity ownership of nursing homes and bars nursing homes from requiring residents to sign arbitration agreements.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the Senate calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOSPITAL UNCOMPENSATED CARE.
bills.summary: Expands hospital financial assistance to patients and reimburses it in a voluntary assistance program.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the Senate calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT EXEMPTING HOSPITAL BEDS FOR HOME HEALTH CARE USE FROM THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
bills.summary: Exempts hospital beds for home health care use from sales and use taxes.
bills.latest_action: Referred to committee; no hearing

bills.title: AN ACT STUDYING ACCESS TO PARKING FOR HOME HEALTH CARE SERVICE PROVIDERS.
bills.summary: Requires the Emergency Services and Public Protection commissioner to establish a working group on parking access for home health care providers.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT REQUIRING DATA TRANSPARENCY FOR SELF-DIRECTED HOME CARE PROGRAMS.
bills.summary: Requires the Department of Social Services to report additional data quarterly on self-directed home care programs.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR FULL-TIME HOME HEALTH CARE COSTS.
bills.summary: Creates a personal income tax deduction of up to sixty thousand dollars for full-time home health care costs.
bills.latest_action: Public hearing held; no committee vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF FISCAL INTERMEDIARIES BY STATE AGENCIES FOR PAYROLL SERVICES.
bills.summary: Requires state agency contracts with fiscal intermediaries for payroll services to include penalties for late payroll processing.
bills.latest_action: Public hearing held; no committee vote

bills.title: AN ACT MAKING DEFICIENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2026.
bills.summary: Makes deficiency appropriations for fiscal year 2026 to implement the Governor's budget recommendations.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT PROTECTING RENTERS FROM RENT INCREASES UPON CHANGE OF OWNERSHIP.
bills.summary: Governor's bill limiting rent increases when a property changes ownership.
bills.latest_action: Referred to committee; no hearing

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAL ASSISTANCE FOR UNDOCUMENTED IMMIGRANTS AND HUSKY C ASSET LIMITS.
bills.summary: Seeks to target state medical assistance to the most vulnerable residents, addressing coverage for undocumented immigrants and HUSKY C asset limits.
bills.latest_action: Referred to committee; no hearing

bills.title: AN ACT REQUIRING FEAR OF RETALIATION TRAINING FOR PERSONS PROVIDING ASSISTED LIVING SERVICES IN MANAGED RESIDENTIAL COMMUNITIES.
bills.summary: Requires assisted living services agencies in managed residential communities to give employees annual in-service training on residents' fear of retaliation.
bills.latest_action: Signed by the Governor

bills.title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE COLLECTION OF IDENTIFYING INFORMATION OF NONRESIDENT OWNERS OF RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY.
bills.summary: Requires collection of identifying information about nonresident owners of residential property.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT REESTABLISHING THE LEGISLATIVE PROGRAM REVIEW AND INVESTIGATIONS COMMITTEE.
bills.summary: Reestablishes the Legislative Program Review and Investigations Committee.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; no floor vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING TENANT ORGANIZATIONAL ACTIVITIES.
bills.summary: Requires landlords to permit certain tenant organizational activities in residential property.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT ALLOWING TRAINED ASSISTED LIVING AIDES TO ADMINISTER MEDICATION TO ASSISTED LIVING RESIDENTS.
bills.summary: Allows trained assisted living aides to administer medication to assisted living residents.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; no floor vote

bills.title: AN ACT REQUIRING NOTIFICATION TO THE LEGISLATIVE LEADERS OF THE PROPOSED ADOPTION OF REGULATIONS AND OF THE STATE BUILDING AND FIRE CODES.
bills.summary: Requires state agencies to electronically notify legislative leaders when they begin adopting regulations, the State Building Code, Fire Prevention Code and Fire Safety Code.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING DOMESTIC VIOLENCE AND TENANT SCREENING.
bills.summary: Prohibits denying a rental application on the basis of credit history when the applicant is a domestic violence victim.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING DISCLOSURE OF WAGE RANGES AND BENEFITS ON PUBLIC AND INTERNAL JOB ADVERTISEMENTS.
bills.summary: Requires employers to disclose wages or wage range and benefits in public and internal job postings, provide annual wage and benefit information to employees, and bars retaliation.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A VETERANS' AND MILITARY HEALTHCARE OMBUDSMAN FOR THE COORDINATION AND OVERSIGHT OF STATE AND LOCAL RESOURCES IN NAVIGATING FEDERAL HEALTH CARE BENEFITS FOR VETERANS, MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES AND THEIR FAMILIES.
bills.summary: Establishes a Veterans' Health Care Ombudsman to coordinate and oversee state and local resources for navigating the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs health care system.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT PROMOTING THE DEVELOPMENT OF ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS.
bills.summary: Renames accessory apartments as accessory dwelling units, repeals municipal opt-out, limits enforcement of certain land use restrictions, and creates a preapproved ADU program at the Housing Commissioner.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH'S RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING VARIOUS REVISIONS TO THE PUBLIC HEALTH STATUTES.
bills.summary: Implements the Department of Public Health's recommendations for various revisions to the public health statutes.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; on the House calendar, no vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE PROBATE COURTS.
bills.summary: Funds higher pay for court-appointed conservators, in line with the minimum wage increase and the PA 25-48 working group.
bills.latest_action: Referred to committee; no hearing

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF LONG-TERM CARE NEEDS.
bills.summary: Requires the Commissioner of Social Services to study long-term care needs in the state.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; no floor vote

bills.title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR RENTAL ASSISTANCE PROGRAM HOUSING INSPECTIONS.
bills.summary: Appropriates funds to the Department of Housing to hire additional full-time rental home inspectors for the rental assistance program.
bills.latest_action: Committee approved; no floor vote

bills.title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOSPITAL SALE-LEASEBACK TRANSACTIONS AND ATTESTATIONS CONCERNING LACK OF A CONTROLLING INTEREST OF A HOSPITAL OR OF INTERFERENCE WITH THE PROFESSIONAL JUDGMENT AND CLINICAL DECISIONS OF CERTAIN HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS OF A HOSPITAL BY A PRIVATE EQUITY ENTITY.
bills.summary: Permits financially distressed hospitals to enter sale-leaseback agreements under certain circumstances and requires hospitals to attest that no private equity entity controls them or interferes with clinical judgment.
bills.latest_action: Signed by the Governor

bills.title: AN ACT REPEALING SECURITY DEPOSIT MAXIMUMS.
bills.summary: Repeals the statutory maximum of one or two months' rent that a landlord may require as a security deposit.
bills.latest_action: Public hearing held; no committee vote

bills.title: AN ACT LIMITING THE ACCESS OF PRIVATE EQUITY TO FUNDS FROM THE EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATION ENDOWMENT.
